title: Reports: selectable contiguous 3- and 6-month ranges using month/year selectors

requirements.summary: Replace the 3 Months “Reference Date” date picker with a month/year selector that chooses a contiguous 3-month window.
acceptanceCriteria: When Report Type = "3 Months", the configuration UI shows a month/year-based selector (not a date input) for choosing the desired 3-month period.
The computed report period covers exactly 3 full consecutive calendar months (inclusive), based on the user’s selection.
The Financial Summary header reflects the correct start and end dates for the selected 3-month range.
No runtime errors occur when switching between Monthly and 3 Months report types.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable month/year-based selector component for choosing the start month/year of a contiguous multi-month window (configured for 3 months here) and displaying appropriate labels/hints about the resulting range.

Update the Reports configuration UI so that when reportType is '3month' it renders MultiMonthRangeSelector (month/year) instead of the 'Reference Date' <input type="date">; add state for the selected 3-month window start month/year and ensure switching between 'monthly' and '3month' keeps selector state valid (no NaN dates).

requirements.summary: Replace the 6 Months “Reference Date” date picker with a month/year selector that chooses a contiguous 6-month window.
acceptanceCriteria: When Report Type = "6 Months", the configuration UI shows a month/year-based selector (not a date input) for choosing the desired 6-month period.
The computed report period covers exactly 6 full consecutive calendar months (inclusive), based on the user’s selection.
The Financial Summary header reflects the correct start and end dates for the selected 6-month range.
No runtime errors occur when switching between Monthly and 6 Months report types.

file_operations.description: Update the Reports configuration UI so that when reportType is '6month' it renders MultiMonthRangeSelector configured for a 6-month window; add/extend state for the 6-month window start month/year (may share the same start-month state as 3-month) and ensure switching between 'monthly' and '6month' keeps selector state valid (no NaN dates).

requirements.summary: Centralize and standardize report date-range calculations for Monthly, 3 Months, and 6 Months as full-month windows independent of arbitrary day-based reference dates.
acceptanceCriteria: For Monthly, 3 Months, and 6 Months report types, startDate is the first day of the first selected month and endDate is the last day of the last month in the window (end-of-day).
Switching report types preserves/updates relevant selector state without causing invalid dates or NaN timestamps.
Expenses, revenue, and COGS queries/filtering use the updated start/end timestamps and display correct results for the selected windows.

file_operations.description: Add shared, well-tested utility functions to compute full-month windows (monthly, 3 months, 6 months) from a selected start month/year (start = first day of first month; end = last day of last month at end-of-day), and optionally a helper for daily ranges.

Refactor useMemo date-range computation to use the new dateRanges utilities for 'monthly', '3month', and '6month' (full-month windows), removing reliance on selectedDate for multi-month report types; keep startTimestamp/endTimestamp derivation and ensure downstream filtering and COGS query use the updated timestamps.
